encoding: RGBA 8 bit: R = illumination 0..1 -> round(250 x), G = Earth visibility 0..1 -> round(250 x), B = round(4 x slope in degrees), slope capped at 63.75 deg; alpha 255 valid, 254 missing (RGB 0)

metrics.illumination: mean visible fraction of the solar disc over the period (disc of the true angular radius against a locally straight horizon, linear horizon interpolation between azimuth bins)
metrics.earth: fraction of time steps with the Earth's centre above the horizon
metrics.psr: permanently shadowed: in no azimuth bin does the highest upper solar limb (disc centre + angular radius) over the envelope period rise above the horizon
metrics.slope: terrain slope in degrees, central differences on the output grid

psr_envelope.definition: permanently shadowed: in no azimuth bin does the highest upper solar limb (disc centre + angular radius) over the envelope period rise above the horizon

horizon.near_field: per pixel, straight map rays, step max(pixel, 2 % of distance), curvature d²/2R
horizon.far_field: great-circle rays from nodes every 250 m, 5000 m to 250000 m, step 1.5 % of distance, exact 3D

sun_disc: true angular radius from SPICE distance (R_sun from pck00011)
earth: centre only (disc ~1.9 deg not modelled); apparent direction from the site

kernels.name: pck00011.tpc
kernels.purpose: body radii (Sun radius for the disc)

master.product: NASA PGDA product 81: LOLA 5 m/px DEM mosaic 87-90°S (ldem_87s_5mpp.tif), Barker et al. 2021, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119

context.product: NASA PGDA product 90, LOLA south polar DEM 80-90 S, LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (Barker et al.); heights in metres above 1737.4 km

pgda_comparison.note: orientation: PGDA product 69 (Mazarico et al.) maps give the fraction of time with any part of the solar disc (resp. the Earth) visible, averaged over ~18.6 years on LDEM_85S_060M; ours cover one year from the run date

provenance.source: NASA PGDA LOLA 5 m/px south polar mosaic
provenance.method: HTTP range reads of the tiles covering the clip; Deflate + floating-point predictor decoded; heights in metres copied unchanged (no resampling) into a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF master (lossless Deflate + floating-point predictor, 512 px tiles); internal overviews: NaN-aware mean of 2x2 blocks of the next finer level
